f27d43f9f6b0: Write a user comment · translationCore 4 Help
c41f12a9a0a9: A comment is your own note about a section or verse, and it stays with the project.
187773781cd8: In Understand, choose Section or Verse next to Comment by (1).
1b68b65029e4: Click in the box under the section or verse (2) and type your comment.
7be660c4a844: Click outside the box. The comment is saved; watch the indicator at the top right.
703fd837a2ff: Later, in Translate, click Comments in the helps panel to read it.
be76e7f1ab15: To change a comment, edit the text and click outside again.
da9bca00c426: A saved comment can't be emptied: "A saved user comment cannot be emptied — user comments are permanent in this version." Change the text instead.
76d4bd8cd258: In Section view, if you wrote comments on single verses inside the section, tC4 suggests switching to Verse to see each one.
6c3207140f2b: These comments are separate from check comments. See Write a check comment.
41c4ead31bdb: A section in Understand: Comment by, with Section selected, is marked 1. Under the passage of Titus 1:1–3 is the empty comment box, marked 2, which asks What is this section saying? Who is speaking, to whom, and what will be hard to render?
